```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/site.R")
publication <- read_publication("out/release/elo")
counts <- publication$manifest$source$match_counts
```

**Publication cutoff: `r publication$manifest$analysis$as_of`.**
All downloads below belong to this publication.

| Download | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| [Current ratings](../out/release/elo/latest.csv) | Every rated team, with active/provisional flags, current rank, and last rated match |
| [Monthly history](../out/release/elo/monthly.csv) | Calendar-month-end ratings for each format and team |
| [Match updates](../out/release/elo/updates.csv) | Both teams' ratings before and after every rated match |
| [Publication metadata](../out/release/elo/manifest.json) | Model specification, source receipts, and file checksums |

## Coverage

```{r}
#| results: asis
coverage <- data.frame(
  Format = names(counts), Matches = as.integer(unlist(counts)),
  `Latest result` = unlist(publication$manifest$analysis$last_result[names(counts)]), check.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(coverage, format = "html", escape = TRUE)
```

The match counts include no-results, which do not contribute rating updates.
The source is ESPNcricinfo's annual
[match-results tables](https://stats.espncricinfo.com/ci/engine/records/team/match_results.html?class=1;id=2025;type=year).
Collection starts in 1877 for Tests, 1971 for ODIs, and 2005 for T20Is. Coverage
is the set of matches listed there; it has not been independently certified as a census.

## Using the files

Join by stable team and match IDs, and keep formats separate. A missing current
rank indicates an inactive team. Month-end history excludes incomplete months;
use the current-ratings file for the latest cutoff.

The files are regenerated together after successful checks. Earlier publications
remain available through the repository's
[publication history](https://github.com/outside-edge/elo_cricket/commits/main/out/release/elo).

Charts can be downloaded as SVG or PNG from the [Test](test.qmd), [ODI](odi.qmd),
and [T20I](t20i.qmd) pages. See [methods](methods.qmd) for the rating definitions.
